_comment: Seconds each E2E scenario package took (package elapsed, go test -json) in one
run of the whole suite in a 4-CPU offline Docker container (2026-11-06).
scripts/ci/e2e_shards.py packs whole packages onto the CI shards by these
weights; a package missing here gets the script's default weight. Refresh
after adding or growing a scenario package: python3 scripts/ci/e2e_shards.py --count 3 --plan
